title: Intensity as a modern taste
summary: He says intensity is a modern desire and that styles swing back and forth.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: It was a brighter band in person you mean?
Yeah, and it had more--I would say style.

Intensity is a modern colloquial desire. It's something that is of today. It goes along with electricity, and maybe that isn't the most desirable thing and in my lifetime it's taken a couple of swings.
There was a time when intensity was not wanted at all. After the war, everything was so slack, but there are other values; that's not the only one.
